q: The Domo app is crashing when the CEO attempts to launch it.
a: The advisor provided troubleshooting steps such as updating the app, uninstalling and reinstalling, but no clear resolution was confirmed.

q: User is having trouble logging into the Domo mobile app after replacing their mobile device.
a: The Domo advisor offered to schedule a Zoom call to further troubleshoot the issue.

q: How to launch the Domo mobile app from an email link instead of opening in a browser.
a: Provided steps to configure launching the Domo mobile app from email links on iPad.

q: We cannot view scheduled report cards on mobile devices, only on PCs. Is there a way to open the Domo app instead of the browser?
a: The advisor investigated the issue further and requested permission to access the customer's Domo environment for the development team to assist.

q: The customer wants to know if it's possible to export data from a Domo card to an Excel file via the Domo mobile app.
a: The advisor confirmed that exporting data to Excel is not available in the Domo mobile app, only in the web browser.

q: The customer is getting an error when attempting to log into one of their Domo organizations from the mobile app.
a: The mobile access was restricted for the demo account, and the customer needs to contact their Customer Success Manager to enable this feature.

q: Customer is asking about using the Domo mobile app for iOS to view dashboards on iPhone and iPad.
a: The advisor confirmed that the customer would need to install the iOS version of the Domo mobile app to view dashboards on iPhone and iPad, and that the same dashboard can be viewed on both PC and iOS.

q: One user is facing an error on their Domo app homepage (iPad) where it is not loading.
a: The advisor asked the user to update the Domo app, restart the iPad, and check if a specific dashboard loads on the iPad.

q: Receiving 'Failed to Update' notifications on iPhone app for specific cards.
a: Suggested troubleshooting steps like reinstalling the app and adjusting dashboard settings.

q: Asking about an efficient way to pin a specific dashboard to the mobile home screen for 150+ stores.
a: Currently there is no way to customize the mobile home screen's tile arrangement for multiple users at once.

q: User wants to redirect employees to the Domo mobile app if browsing on a cellphone.
a: The advisor provided steps to update the Domo web and mobile landing page for users.

q: Unable to sign in to the Domo mobile app and reset password.
a: The Bass Pro IT team was engaged to resolve the password reset issue.

q: Questions about exporting data to Excel from the Domo iPhone app and publishing custom apps to the App Store.
a: The advisor explained the current limitations and future roadmap for those capabilities.

q: Unable to sign into Domo mobile app, getting error message.
a: Suggested checking with customer's SSO/identity team, offered to setup call.

q: Korea users unable to get Windows login authentication popup on iPads.
a: The issue was resolved after the users updated their iPad OS version.

q: Facing issue with displaying Domo reports on iPad using the slideshow feature.
a: After some back-and-forth, the advisor recommended trying a different browser (Chrome) to resolve the issue.

q: Unable to view client apps that have been shared on the Domo mobile app.
a: The issue seems to have been resolved, but no specific solution was provided.

q: The 'Clear Condition' button script does not clear the input value on the mobile app but works fine on the desktop app.
a: The issue is caused by using an older iOS version. Updating to the latest iOS should resolve the problem.

q: A question on the community forum about accessing App Studio in subscriber instances on the Domo mobile app.
a: no substantive answer recorded

q: Card titles missing in mobile view for dashboard.
a: Card descriptions are used as labels instead of titles for dropdown filters on mobile.
